name: Rance 01 - Hikari o Motomete -
original_name: ランス01 光をもとめて
source:
Brutal warrior Rance's mind is filled to the brim with thoughts of fucking girls. And wherever he goes, screams of beautiful women resound.

He's been traveling around randomly with the mage girl he recently bought, Sill, but now he has a different purpose in mind. His target this time... Or rather, his destination, is the Kingdom of Leazas, which is known to be the most wealthy nation in the world. The daughter of a noble family, Hikari, who attended Paris Academy there, has gone missing, and he's taken up a quest to find her.

Rance sets off to enjoy the beauties of Leazas!
...And while he's there, he'll find Hikari and enjoy her too, of course.

[From [url=https://jastusa.com/games/manga004/rance-01-+-02]JAST USA[/url]]

This is a remake of the original Rance title which came out 24 years prior. It uses an old-style chip-based battle system and has new artwork and music. The script has also been heavily modified.
translation:
残暴的战士兰斯满脑子都是和女人上床的念头。无论走到哪里，都回荡着美丽女人的尖叫声。

他一直和最近买下的魔法使少女希露漫无目的地四处旅行，但如今心中有了不同的目标。这一次的目标……或者说目的地，是以世界上最富裕的国家闻名的利萨斯王国。贵族家的女儿小光曾在那里就读帕丽斯学院，如今下落不明，于是他接下了寻找她的委托。

兰斯出发去享受利萨斯的美人们！
……当然，他也会在那里找到小光，好好享受她。

[译自[url=https://jastusa.com/games/manga004/rance-01-+-02]JAST USA[/url]]

这是24年前推出的初代《兰斯》的重制版。游戏采用老式的芯片式战斗系统，并加入了全新的美术与音乐，剧本也经过大幅修改。
